disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 SSH 凭据处理路径：机器注册表只在本机保存用户显式输入的密码或私钥路径，界面回显前会剥离密码字段；私钥只在用户显式提供路径时读取，代码注释与文档均声明不自动读取 ~/.ssh 目录。
checked_items.en: Checked the SSH credential handling path: the machine registry only saves user-entered passwords or private key paths locally, and the password field is stripped before UI echo; private keys are only read when the user explicitly provides a path. Code comments and documentation both state that the ~/.ssh directory is not auto-read.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 ~/.ssh/config 导入功能：只解析 Host/HostName/User/Port/IdentityFile/ProxyJump 等连接元数据，IdentityFile 仅作路径引用，不读取密钥内容；测试用例亦只校验解析结果。
checked_items.en: Checked the ~/.ssh/config import feature: it only parses connection metadata such as Host/HostName/User/Port/IdentityFile/ProxyJump. IdentityFile is used only as a path reference, never reading key contents; test cases only validate parse results.

checked_items.zh: 检查了系统钥匙串集成（macOS Keychain / Windows DPAPI / Linux secret-tool）：密码通过系统凭据存储读写，调用均为固定系统命令，未发现凭据外发路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the system keychain integration (macOS Keychain / Windows DPAPI / Linux secret-tool): passwords are read and written through the system credential store, all calls invoke fixed system commands, and no credential exfiltration path was found.

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中 19 处 ~/.ssh 相关文本，全部为文档、界面文案或解析器说明，未发现读取私钥/凭据文件并外发的代码；未检出硬编码密钥、云凭据枚举或钱包资产访问。
checked_items.en: Static scan hit 19 occurrences of ~/.ssh-related text, all in documentation, UI copy, or parser notes. No code that reads private keys/credential files and exfiltrates them was found; no hardcoded keys, cloud credential enumeration, or wallet asset access detected.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部凭据读取面：~/.ssh/config 仅解析 Host 元数据、不读密钥内容；私钥仅显式路径读取；机器密码存本机注册表或系统钥匙串，未发现读取凭据后外发的链路。
evidence.en: Checked all credential read surfaces: ~/.ssh/config only parses Host metadata and does not read key contents; private keys are only read via explicit paths; machine passwords are stored in the local registry or system keychain. No chain that reads credentials and exfiltrates them was found.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了全部 20 余个模型工具的说明文本：均为 SSH/SFTP 远程文件与命令操作的功能描述，未发现指令覆写、伪造系统消息、要求读取凭据或诱导安装的措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text of all 20+ model tools one by one: they are all functional descriptions of SSH/SFTP remote file and command operations. No wording that overwrites instructions, forges system messages, demands credential reads, or induces installation was found.

checked_items.zh: 审查了注入系统提示的远程工作区段落：仅在会话工作目录映射到远程镜像时注入，内容为远程路径与可用工具引导，无越权指令。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the remote workspace section injected into the system prompt: it is only injected when the session working directory maps to a remote image, and the content is a guide to remote paths and available tools, with no elevated commands.

checked_items.zh: 全树搜索 agent 指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、MCP 配置、编辑器自动化配置、隐藏 HTML 注释指令等）：未发现。
checked_items.en: Searched the entire tree for agent instruction files (e.g., AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, MCP config, editor automation config, hidden HTML comment directives, etc.): none found.

checked_items.zh: 未检出伪装高权限消息、隐藏指令、远程指令拉取或审批绕过类措辞。
checked_items.en: No disguised high-permission messages, hidden instructions, remote instruction pulls, or approval-bypass wording detected.

evidence.zh: 20 余个 rw_* 工具的说明均为远程操作描述，无指令覆写、凭据诱导或隐藏意图；注入系统提示的远程工作区段落为会话路径与工具引导，无越权指令。
evidence.en: The descriptions of all 20+ rw_* tools are remote operation descriptions, with no instruction overwrites, credential phishing, or hidden intent. The remote workspace section injected into the system prompt is a session path and tool guide, with no elevated commands.

evidence.zh: 工具说明与系统提示中未发现诱导执行插件安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: No wording in tool descriptions or system prompts that induces plugin installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation was found.

checked_items.zh: 未检出 eval / new Function / node:vm 等动态执行构造。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution constructs such as eval / new Function / node:vm detected.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁中的动态表达式为侧边栏防重复挂载守卫，只读取加载器状态判断是否已挂载同类组件，无文件、网络或凭据操作。
checked_items.en: The dynamic expression in the patch config is a guard that prevents duplicate sidebar mounting; it only reads loader state to determine whether a similar component is already mounted, with no file, network, or credential operations.

checked_items.zh: 系统命令调用仅限固定系统工具（钥匙串、本机目录选择器），参数不经过 shell，无注入面。
checked_items.en: System command invocations are limited to fixed system tools (keychain, local directory picker); parameters are not passed through a shell, so there is no injection surface.

checked_items.zh: 未检出安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），CI 工作流为标准测试与语法检查流水线，仓库内无 husky/lefthook/devcontainer 等树内执行载体。
checked_items.en: No install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) detected. CI workflows are standard test and syntax-check pipelines; no in-tree execution carriers such as husky/lefthook/devcontainer are present in the repository.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端客户端脚本只调用本插件自身的 /dsh-remote/* 接口，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或调用宿主凭据写入接口。
checked_items.en: Browser-side client scripts only call this plugin's own /dsh-remote/* endpoints. No keyboard listening, clipboard reads, or calls to host credential write interfaces were found.

checked_items.zh: 机制观察：自更新功能默认 manual，auto 需用户显式开启，更新从 npm 官方 registry 经 HTTPS 拉取并替换插件自身文件。
checked_items.en: Mechanism observation: self-update is set to manual by default; auto requires explicit user opt-in. Updates are pulled from the official npm registry over HTTPS and replace the plugin's own files.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁含框架许可的动态表达式，载荷为固定守卫函数：扫描补丁栈与加载器条目判断侧边栏组件是否已挂载，只读加载器状态，无文件、网络或凭据操作；变更日志中相关文本为问题修复说明。
evidence.en: The patch config contains framework-permitted dynamic expressions; the payload is a fixed guard function that scans the patch stack and loader entries to determine whether the sidebar component is already mounted. It only reads loader state, with no file, network, or credential operations. The related text in the changelog is a bug-fix description.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态代码执行工具（如 cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，未检出 node:vm 等宿主内执行构造。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic code execution tools (e.g., cordis_define/cordis_run) detected, nor in-host execution constructs such as node:vm.

evidence.zh: 包清单无安装钩子；仓库内未发现 husky/lefthook/devcontainer 等树内执行载体；CI 工作流仅运行语法检查、静态门禁与单元测试。
evidence.en: The package manifest has no install hooks; no in-tree execution carriers such as husky/lefthook/devcontainer are present in the repository; CI workflows only run syntax checks, static gates, and unit tests.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端客户端并自动加载进 Web 界面；客户端脚本仅调用本插件 /dsh-remote/* 接口（设置、文件浏览、侧边栏编辑），未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或宿主凭据写入调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side client and auto-loads it into the Web UI. The client scripts only call this plugin's /dsh-remote/* endpoints (settings, file browser, sidebar editing). No keyboard listening, clipboard reads, or host credential write calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部外联点：SSH/SFTP 连接目标为用户配置的远程主机；版本检查与更新仅访问 npm 官方 registry（HTTPS 固定域名）；界面链接指向插件 GitHub 仓库。

checked_items.zh: 未发现凭据读取与网络发送的组合链路，未发现编码外发、带外通道、DNS 隧道或 AI 端点劫持。
checked_items.en: No combined chain of credential reading and network sending was found, nor encoded exfiltration, out-of-band channels, DNS tunneling, or AI endpoint hijacking.

checked_items.zh: 开发脚本中的网络请求仅为对 127.0.0.1 本地服务的健康检查，不随包发布。
checked_items.en: Network requests in development scripts are only health checks against the local service on 127.0.0.1 and are not shipped with the package.

evidence.zh: 外联仅限用户配置的 SSH 主机与 npm 官方 registry（HTTPS 固定域名，版本检查/更新用）；未发现凭据加外发组合、编码外泄或非声明端点。
evidence.en: Outbound connections are limited to user-configured SSH hosts and the official npm registry (HTTPS fixed domain, used for version checks/updates). No credential-plus-exfiltration combination, encoded leakage, or undeclared endpoints were found.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：ssh2、iconv-lite、@deepseek-ai/schemastery、dsh-better-sidebar 及 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 宿主包均为正常生态包，未见疑似仿冒或抢注名称。
checked_items.en: Dependency list verified: ssh2, iconv-lite, @deepseek-ai/schemastery, dsh-better-sidebar, and @deepseek-ai/dsh-* host packages are all legitimate ecosystem packages; no suspicious impersonation or squatting names were found.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁只插入自身上屏行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未禁用安全行，未用环境变量降权，未改写注入或拦截配置。

checked_items.zh: 未发现对工具预执行、审批请求等安全事件的高优监听或审批链截断。

checked_items.en: This is the first audit, so there is no prior version baseline. The upgrade auto-activation dimension is not applicable. The author account and repository name match, and there are no signs of impersonation.

checked_items.en: Mechanism observation: in auto mode, self-update silently applies the npm latest version and replaces the plugin's own files, but this mode requires explicit user opt-in and the update source is the official registry.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁仅插入自身上屏行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未禁用安全行，未用环境变量降权。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts its own UI line; it does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not disable security lines, and does not downgrade via environment variables.

evidence.zh: 未发现对工具预执行、审批请求等安全事件的高优监听或吞掉回调的截断行为。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners for security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests, nor callback-swallowing truncation behavior, were found.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法做版本间清单突变检测。
evidence.en: This is the first audit, so there is no previous version baseline to compare against; cross-version manifest mutation detection is not possible.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写注入或拦截配置；插件自身声明依赖的宿主服务（工具、系统提示、Web 服务）均为正常必需服务。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configs; the host services the plugin itself declares as dependencies (tools, system prompt, Web service) are all normal and necessary.

checked_items.zh: 审查了注册到宿主 Web 服务的路由：全部位于 /dsh-remote/ 前缀，功能与设置界面、侧边栏、模型工具对应，未见越权接口。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the routes registered with the host Web service: they are all under the /dsh-remote/ prefix and correspond to the settings UI, sidebar, and model tools; no unauthorized interfaces were found.

checked_items.zh: 端口转发功能监听本机回环地址，方向与目标由用户或模型显式指定；会话级远程上下文注入已做作用域隔离。
checked_items.en: The port-forwarding feature listens on the local loopback address, and the direction and targets are explicitly specified by the user or model. Session-level remote context injection is scoped and isolated.

checked_items.zh: 本机 Web 服务无认证属 dsh 宿主固有风险（宿主文档明示其围栏只是可达性策略而非认证层），非本插件引入；动态沙箱未启用，运行时行为仅做静态审查。
checked_items.en: The lack of authentication on the local Web service is an inherent risk of the dsh host (the host documentation states its fence is only an accessibility policy, not an authentication layer), not introduced by this plugin. The dynamic sandbox is not enabled, so runtime behavior was only statically reviewed.

evidence.zh: 本机 Web 服务无认证属 dsh 宿主固有风险，插件仅向宿主 Web 服务注册 /dsh-remote/* 路由，未自建监听服务；按生态固有风险标注，不适用。
evidence.en: The lack of authentication on the local Web service is an inherent risk of the dsh host. The plugin only registers /dsh-remote/* routes with the host Web service and does not create its own listening service. Marked as not applicable since it's an inherent ecosystem risk.

summary.en: Metadata check: dsh declarations (bundle/client), package name, author, and dependencies all look normal, with no signs of impersonation.

静态预扫命中 29 条已逐条人工裁决，全部为良性，未产生发现项：DSH-P01/DG-R3-51——挂载补丁的动态表达式是框架许可的防重复挂载守卫（只读加载器状态，无文件/网络/凭据操作），变更日志中的相关文本为问题修复说明；DSH-C01/DG-R1-51——19 处 ~/.ssh 相关命中均为文档、界面文案与 ssh 配置解析器说明，解析器只提取 Host/HostName/User/Port/IdentityFile（路径引用）/ProxyJump 元数据，从不读取私钥内容；DSH-X03/DG-R3-55——两处系统命令调用为系统钥匙串与本机目录选择器的固定二进制，参数不经 shell，无注入面；DSH-T02/DG-R2-52——系统提示段为远程工作区上下文，无指令覆写或凭据诱导措辞；DSH-X07/DG-R3-59——CI 工作流为标准测试/语法检查流水线，无外联与凭证操作；DSH-C05/DG-R4-53——开发脚本对 127.0.0.1 本地服务的健康检查，不随包发布。

机制观察（不构成发现项）：自更新功能默认 manual，auto 模式需用户显式开启，更新从 npm 官方 registry 经 HTTPS 拉取并替换插件自身文件；tarball 解包的文件名过滤允许 lib/ 前缀后的 .. 段（理论上可写出解包目录），但该路径仅在 npm registry 被攻陷或包被劫持时可达，此时攻击者本可直接替换插件代码，故未单独立项；机器密码默认以明文存于注册表文件，用户可逐台开启系统钥匙串加密保存，属文档化的设计取舍。
limits.en:
Dynamic sandbox validation not performed: no dynamic validation artifacts in the context directory, so DG-L4 is recorded as not applicable. Runtime behavior was only statically and semantically reviewed.

Static pre-scan hits (29) were individually adjudicated, all benign with no findings: DSH-P01/DG-R3-51—the dynamic expression in the patch config is a framework-permitted guard against duplicate mounting (reads loader state only, no file/network/credential operations); the related text in the changelog is a bug-fix description. DSH-C01/DG-R1-51—the 19 ~/.ssh-related hits are all documentation, UI copy, and ssh config parser notes; the parser only extracts Host/HostName/User/Port/IdentityFile (path reference)/ProxyJump metadata and never reads private key contents. DSH-X03/DG-R3-55—the two system command calls are fixed binaries for the system keychain and local directory picker; parameters are not passed through a shell, so there is no injection surface. DSH-T02/DG-R2-52—the system prompt section is remote workspace context, with no instruction overwrite or credential-phishing wording. DSH-X07/DG-R3-59—CI workflows are standard test/syntax-check pipelines, with no outbound connections or credential operations. DSH-C05/DG-R4-53—development scripts' health checks against the local service on 127.0.0.1 are not shipped with the package.

Mechanism observations (not findings): self-update defaults to manual; auto mode requires explicit user opt-in, and updates are pulled from the official npm registry over HTTPS and replace the plugin's own files. The tarball extraction filename filter permits `..` segments after the lib/ prefix (theoretically allowing writes outside the extraction directory), but this path is only reachable if the npm registry is compromised or the package is hijacked, in which case the attacker could directly replace plugin code, so it was not raised as a separate item. Machine passwords are stored in plaintext in the registry file by default; users can enable system keychain encryption per host, which is a documented design trade-off.
